alternative_assumption: the approved baseline (registered-export core-ready sessions, crossover quarantined, exact repeats left out of sums, file-specific +3h)
baseline_assumption: the approved baseline (registered-export core-ready sessions, crossover quarantined, exact repeats left out of sums, file-specific +3h)
interpretation: The approved metric package (M1 499 g, M2 1,039.6 g, M3 1,697, M4 5, M5 99.88%, S2 97.88%).
name: Approved baseline
rationale: The frozen approved interpretation; every other scenario is compared with it.

alternative_assumption: both registered-export versions are counted as ordinary sessions
baseline_assumption: session2266 and session3222 are quarantined in both populations
decision_impact: none: the quarantine stays; M5 must never be reported this way
interpretation: M1, M2 and M4 barely move; M5 rises to 100% only because the quarantine is lifted, which is not a valid readiness figure.
name: Crossover sessions included (both)
rationale: What if the quarantine were lifted? Shows the effect is small on weights and that readiness would be 100% only because the check was removed.

alternative_assumption: session2266 (an exact cross-export duplicate) counted once in the registered-export population
interpretation: Adds a duplicate tray pass; effect on weights is negligible.
name: Only session2266 included
rationale: Isolates the exact duplicate: it would add a second copy of one tray pass.

alternative_assumption: session3222 (a version conflict between the exports) counted in the registered-export population
interpretation: One conflicted session moves M2 by about 3 g.
name: Only session3222 included
rationale: Isolates the version-conflict session.

alternative_assumption: that whole session is left out (analytic only)
baseline_assumption: the session holding the 2,097 g event stays in the population
decision_impact: none: the event stays in canonical data and in the baseline
interpretation: Removing the session shifts M2 by about -1.6 g: the observation is immaterial.
name: 2,097 g session removed
rationale: The 2,097 g event is an UNUSUAL observation, not an INVALID one. Tests whether it drives the result.

alternative_assumption: only that event is dropped from its session's weight
baseline_assumption: the event counts in its session's weight
interpretation: Same effect on M2 as removing the session.
name: 2,097 g event removed (session kept)
rationale: Separates the event from the session.

alternative_assumption: sessions outside the data's own 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles are left out
baseline_assumption: no exclusion (B07 [50, 2,200] g is a flag only)
interpretation: Trimming the tails lowers M2 by about 2%.
name: Exclude outside data percentiles P0.5-P99.5
rationale: Compares a data-driven bound with the approved fixed bound.

alternative_assumption: the B07-flagged sessions are left out
baseline_assumption: B07 flags sessions outside [50, 2,200] g but keeps them
interpretation: Lowers M2 by about 2%.
name: Exclude outside the approved B07 range
rationale: What if the diagnostic B07 flag were an exclusion rule?

alternative_assumption: sessions with one weighing event are left out
name: Exclude single-event sessions (B04)
rationale: The 17 single-event sessions are a diagnostic population; do they drive M1?

alternative_assumption: those sessions are left out
baseline_assumption: sessions with a span over 600 s are kept
interpretation: Effect below 3 g.
name: Exclude long sessions (T05)
rationale: Long spans may merge two tray passes; do they drive the result?

alternative_assumption: sessions with a session-level or event-level WARN are left out
baseline_assumption: WARN findings never remove a session
interpretation: M2 falls by about 25 g (2.4%): flagged sessions are somewhat heavier.
name: Exclude every session with any WARN
rationale: What if every flagged session were excluded? Also shows why M5 and S2 differ.

alternative_assumption: the same file shifted by +0h from its raw wall-clock times (all other files unchanged; service-hours rule T03 applied)
assumption_changed: timezone of the suspect registered export
decision_impact: none: contradicted by the cross-export and hour-of-day evidence
interpretation: Raw times are before service hours for many sessions: T03 quarantines 303 of them and M5 falls to 82.05%.
name: Suspect export shifted by +0h
rationale: The source does not confirm the timezone metadata. The offset is tested across the plausible range, only on the named file.

alternative_assumption: the same file shifted by +1h from its raw wall-clock times (all other files unchanged; service-hours rule T03 applied)
assumption_changed: timezone of the suspect registered export
interpretation: Still leaves 103 sessions outside service hours.
name: Suspect export shifted by +1h
rationale: The source does not confirm the timezone metadata. The offset is tested across the plausible range, only on the named file.

alternative_assumption: the same file shifted by +2h from its raw wall-clock times (all other files unchanged; service-hours rule T03 applied)
assumption_changed: timezone of the suspect registered export
decision_impact: none: KPIs cannot separate +2h, +3h and +4h; the cross-export evidence selects +3h
interpretation: No session leaves service hours; KPIs identical to +3h (weights do not depend on the clock). Only the weather join and hour-of-day differ.
name: Suspect export shifted by +2h
rationale: The source does not confirm the timezone metadata. The offset is tested across the plausible range, only on the named file.

alternative_assumption: the same file shifted by +3h from its raw wall-clock times (all other files unchanged; service-hours rule T03 applied)
assumption_changed: timezone of the suspect registered export
interpretation: The approved baseline offset, reproduced.
name: Suspect export shifted by +3h
rationale: The source does not confirm the timezone metadata. The offset is tested across the plausible range, only on the named file.

alternative_assumption: the same file shifted by +4h from its raw wall-clock times (all other files unchanged; service-hours rule T03 applied)
assumption_changed: timezone of the suspect registered export
decision_impact: none: KPIs cannot separate +2h, +3h and +4h; the cross-export evidence selects +3h
interpretation: KPIs identical to +3h; the file's first events would be about 1.5 h later than the other exports'.
name: Suspect export shifted by +4h
rationale: The source does not confirm the timezone metadata. The offset is tested across the plausible range, only on the named file.

alternative_assumption: those days are left out (diagnostic test only)
baseline_assumption: the six days whose observed volume regime differs from the weekday baseline stay included
interpretation: Removes 252 sessions; M2 +26.4 g (2.5%).
name: Exclude the six volume-irregularity days
rationale: Irregularity is a regime finding, not proof of corrupt data. Tests whether those days drive the profile.

alternative_assumption: the final week is left out (diagnostic test only)
interpretation: Effect below 15 g on M2.
name: Exclude 2020-11-16 to 2020-11-20
rationale: Four of the six irregular days fall in this week.

alternative_assumption: the 16 registered-export days under 30 sessions are left out (diagnostic test only)
name: Exclude the 16 low-observed-volume days
rationale: Low-volume days follow the weekday pattern (Thursday and Friday).

alternative_assumption: 2020-10-05 to 2020-10-16 is left out (period sensitivity, not a correction)
decision_impact: M2 is described as period sensitive; the baseline window stays
interpretation: M2 falls by 62.6 g (6%): the upper end of the distribution is period dependent; M1 and M4 are not.
name: Period sensitivity: exclude the first two weeks
rationale: The first two weeks are the period of the +3h file and of cross-export name disagreement. Not called bad data; tests whether the profile is period dependent.

alternative_assumption: components are compared as written
baseline_assumption: components are compared after trim, whitespace collapse and case-fold
interpretation: M4 unchanged.
name: M4 with raw component names
rationale: Tests whether the (deliberately minimal) normalization matters.

alternative_assumption: distinct scales per session
interpretation: M4 unchanged.
name: M4 counted as distinct scales
rationale: A name-free variant of breadth.

alternative_assumption: weighing events per session
interpretation: M4 unchanged.
name: M4 counted as weighing events
rationale: The crudest variant of breadth.

alternative_assumption: exact repeat rows are summed
baseline_assumption: exact repeat rows are left out of sums
interpretation: No headline effect; the rule matters for one session.
name: Exact duplicate rows summed
rationale: Shows what the duplicate rule protects against (one repeated 67 g row).

alternative_assumption: the other export, measured on its own
interpretation: A different population with a different profile: pooling them would be misleading.
name: DIAGNOSTIC: non-registered-export population
rationale: Shows the two exports behave differently; never a KPI source and never pooled.

alternative_assumption: both populations pooled into one set (invalid; shown only to demonstrate population-confounding risk)
decision_impact: none: forbidden; excluded from every range and conclusion
interpretation: Pooling changes the headline numbers by an amount that reflects population mix, not measurement.
name: FORBIDDEN COMPARISON: pooled registered and non-registered sessions
rationale: A guardrail, not a candidate interpretation: it demonstrates why the populations must not be pooled.
